[CREATURE:SPRITE_DARK]
	[CREATURE_CLASS:ALL_CREATURES][DESCRIPTION:The dark sprite is dressed in a black gossamer dress that is frayed and tattered along the bottom edges. Her eyes are as dark as coal and appear to be looking straight through to your soul. Her dark hair is shoulder length and gnarled. You almost catch a glimpse of a row of razor-sharp teeth, but when you turn to look directly at her, you see nothing but her maniacal, close-mouthed smirk that seems to taunt you and chill you at the same time.]
